note: Per-model token rates the cost odometer applies to FREEZE the USD in each cost.json (referenced by its pricing_ref). Rates are POLICY, not a framework fact (project_rule #1) — configurable, and the values below are approximate: VERIFY against current Anthropic pricing before relying on the USD. The four-way split is what makes the cost real: cache_read bills at ~0.1x input and cache_creation at ~1.25x input (5-minute ephemeral), so applying the input rate to all tokens overstates ~10x. Tokens are the immutable fact; this table is the policy that translates them — bump `version` when rates change so historical cost.json snapshots stay reproducible.
